Sam: Quick recap — onboarding Nova13B-v2 across regions with qprofiles FP16,BF16,INT8,FP8. Ran on H100 and A100. Seeing eu-west-1 (EU) A100 p99 much worse than us-east-1. Sharing run command + raw numbers I pulled.

Sam: ```bash
./bench_runner --model nova13b-v2 --qprofiles fp16,bf16,int8,fp8 \
  --gpus h100,a100 --regions us-east-1,eu-west-1,ap-northeast-1 \
  --batch_sizes 1,4 --seq_len 512 --warmup 500 --steps 2000 \
  --kernel_profile remora-v2,cutlass
```

Jin: raw per-region summary (seq_len=512, batch=1 unless noted)
Jin: us-east-1 (H100): FP16 p50=45ms p99=180ms throughput=12k tok/s; INT8 p50=20ms p99=70ms throughput=32k tok/s; FP8 p50=18ms p99=65ms throughput=35k tok/s
Jin: eu-west-1 (A100): FP16 p50=65ms p99=420ms throughput=7.8k tok/s; INT8 p50=36ms p99=210ms throughput=14k tok/s; FP8 p50=43ms p99=260ms throughput=10.5k tok/s
Jin: ap-northeast-1 (H100): FP16 p50=50ms p99=200ms throughput=10.5k tok/s; INT8 p50=22ms p99=80ms throughput=28k tok/s

Maria: TL;DR: H100 shows consistent INT8/FP8 speedups (~2.4-2.6x vs FP16) with minimal quality hit. A100 gains are smaller (INT8 ~1.8x, FP8 marginal) and p99 spikes on A100 in EU are concerning.
Maria: Quality metrics (validation LM & conv QA sample): FP16 ppl=12.4, FP8 ppl=12.6 (+1.6%), INT8 ppl=12.9 (+4%); Rouge-L (conv QA): FP16=41.2, FP8=40.6 (-0.6)
Maria: Kernel observations: remora-v2 gave best tail behavior on H100; on A100 remora sometimes triggers a kernel fallback path that doubles p99. cutlass INT8 path on A100 is more stable.

devops-bot: Benchmark job 2345 finished — https://ci.redwood.internal/bench/2345 — logs, perf traces, and flamegraphs uploaded

Oliver: A few infra notes: eu-west A100 nodes here are `a100-40gb` (shared capacity) while us-east tests ran on `a100-80gb` / dedicated pools. Memory/KV-cache thrashing + different NIC/NUMA pins could explain p99 deltas. Also saw ~25% of samples >512 in EU run which increases KV cache churn.

Sam: Proposal: re-run eu-west with explicit kernel and reserved capacity:
Sam: `--kernel_profile cutlass --reserved=true --batch_sizes 1 --warmup 2000 --kv_cache_size=12GB`

Maria: I'll queue that run and collect perf counters (SM util, L2 evictions, memory bandwidth, kernel fallback logs). Also will enable detailed tracing for the remora->fallback path.

Oliver: If the kernel switch doesn't help, try: reduce quant block size for INT8 and disable some fusion passes on A100 to avoid costly dequantization steps.

Sam: Action items: Maria -> re-run EU with cutlass + reserved, Jin -> prep edge-case eval prompts to stress FP8 failure modes, Oliver -> confirm instance SKUs + infra tags and check noisy-neighbor metrics. I'll update this thread when the new numbers land. :thumbsup:
